text: The Disaster Recovery Funding Arrangements (DRFA) is Australia's primary national funding mechanism for disaster relief and recovery, jointly financed by the Commonwealth and state/territory governments. It operates as a framework under which state and territory governments activate and administer measures tailored to their jurisdictions, often delivered in partnership with local governments and sectoral agencies.,
